        <script><![CDATA[var getUserData = Class.create();
getUserData.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {


	getUserData: function(){
		var userID = this.getParameter('sysparm_userID');

		gs.addInfoMessage('User ID SI ' + userID);

		var userData = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
		userData.get(userID);

		var userDetails = {};

		userDetails.userNum = userData.getValue('mobile_phone');
		userDetails.userEmail = userData.getValue('email');

		return JSON.stringify(userDetails);
	},

    type: 'getUserData'
});]]></script>
